categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Rightongene Biotechnology Co., Ltd. focuses on molecular diagnostics in oncology, including leukemia, lymphoma, solid tumors, and infectious diseases. Its primary business includes R&D, production, and sales of in vitro diagnostic (IVD) products such as molecular diagnostic reagents and instruments, as well as providing scientific research and clinical testing services. The company also operates third-party medical laboratories and is expanding its immunodiagnostic antigen detection product line.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced molecular diagnostic technologies including PCR (real-time fluorescence quantitative PCR, digital PCR), next-generation sequencing (NGS), FISH (fluorescence in situ hybridization), and gene chip platforms. It has proprietary front-end core technologies such as specific primer-probe design, rapid reagent mixture screening, and AI-based multi-factor algorithms. The company also develops immunodiagnostic reagents based on full-spectrum flow cytometry and integrates AI and big data analytics for multi-omics analysis and precision diagnostics.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include research hospitals, medical institutions, pharmaceutical companies, scientific research institutes, third-party testing organizations, and individual patients. The company’s products and services are widely used in clinical diagnosis, risk assessment, disease typing, targeted drug selection, and efficacy monitoring, primarily serving oncology and infectious disease markets in China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and production facilities in Shanghai and subsidiaries in Suzhou, Wuhan, Changsha, Beijing, and Changchun. It also has an overseas subsidiary in Singapore. Its products and services cover domestic markets extensively, including major hospitals and medical centers across China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Rightongene Biotechnology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the development, manufacturing, and sales of molecular diagnostic reagents and instruments, as well as providing clinical testing and scientific research services. It also operates third-party medical laboratories, serving as a service provider in the diagnostic testing value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in molecular diagnostics with sustained high R&D investment (~25.78% of revenue). It focuses on advancing PCR-based technologies, digital PCR, NGS, FISH, and gene chip platforms, alongside AI-driven multi-omics big data analysis. Strategic R&D projects include developing new diagnostic kits for leukemia, lymphoma, solid tumors, and infectious diseases, with emphasis on clinical translation and regulatory approvals. It also strengthens academic collaborations and builds comprehensive patient genetic databases to support precision medicine.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of self-developed molecular diagnostic reagents and instruments, provision of clinical testing services via third-party laboratories, and scientific research services to hospitals and pharmaceutical companies. The company mainly uses a direct sales model supplemented by distributors. It also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the domestic molecular diagnostics market, especially in leukemia and lymphoma molecular diagnostic reagents, with several products being first or exclusive in China. It competes in a rapidly growing but increasingly competitive IVD industry, facing pressure from new entrants and large enterprises. Its core competitiveness is supported by proprietary technologies, extensive product portfolio, and strong academic partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 242.3 million, a 6.16% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 15.76 million, a significant decline compared to prior profitability. Despite short-term financial pressure due to industry demand fluctuations, increased competition, and impairment losses, the company maintains a solid asset base with total assets near RMB 986 million and continues to invest heavily in R&D. Cash flow from operations improved by 33% year-over-year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Rightongene emphasizes its unique value in providing highly sensitive, specific, and clinically validated molecular diagnostic products, particularly in leukemia and lymphoma where it holds exclusive or first-to-market products. Its integration of advanced molecular platforms with AI-driven data analytics enables precise disease typing and prognosis prediction. The company’s comprehensive product portfolio, regulatory approvals, and strong clinical collaborations differentiate it as a trusted partner in precision oncology diagnostics.
